item.subject: science
item.stem:
Vihaan traces the water cycle from sunlight warming a pond and from plants releasing water vapour. He orders evaporation, transpiration, rising and cooling of water vapour, condensation into clouds, and precipitation.

Which sequence is correct?

options.A: Evaporation and transpiration → rising and cooling of water vapour → condensation into clouds → precipitation.
options.B: Evaporation and transpiration → rising and cooling of water vapour → condensation into clouds by evaporation.
options.C: Evaporation and transpiration → rising of water vapour with no cooling → condensation into clouds.
options.D: Evaporation and transpiration → condensation into clouds → rising and cooling of water vapour.
